verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's own docs say flags can target individuals and segments, have an 'Individual targeting' section, and support expiration dates on targeting. That covers including specific users such as beta testers or internal accounts. Excluding specific individuals (deny-lists) is not stated in any quoted span. missing for 10: explicit documentation of excluding or blocking individual users from a flag, detail on allowlist mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of individual-level targeting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target or exclude specific individual users for a flag (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts)

citations.quote: In addition to targeting specific context attributes, you can target individuals, segments, or specific mobile apps and devices.
You can even set expiration dates for flag targeting if you know you only want customers to receive a flag for a specific period of time.
